description: An entry inside a zip archive, Windows 10 compressed folder layout
notes: Recognised by punctuation, not by a signature: libfwsi tests for '/' at abID[38] and abID[44], two spaces at abID[54] and abID[56], ':' at abID[62] and abID[68], and a NUL at abID[74] -- i.e. the shape of 'mm/dd/yyyy  HH:MM:SS' as UTF-16. The name lengths here EXCLUDE the terminator, the opposite of the MTP items.
